text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“Gold Ship has suddenly regained her fire! 
Upon whom will the Goddess of Victory 
bestow her kiiiiissssss!?”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hyahaaa! You can't hit me with that weak 
stuff!! 
Oraaaa! Take thiiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What did you say?! You little...!  
How do you like thiiiiiis!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen unleashes a raging barrage! 
Can Gold Ship dodge it all?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hup! Hah! Kiiieeeeyaaaaahh!! 
Piece of cake!! Come on, give me all 
you've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Out of ammo?! Where's the water 
refilling station...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You think I'm gonna let you get away?! 
Hold it right theeeere!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Go, go, goooo! Whoaaa, run, run, ruuun! 
Eeeek! Run away! Keep it up!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You really think you can challenge 
me to a battle of stamina? 
—Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Incredible speed! Mejiro McQueen pulls 
away in an instant!! 
She reloads her colored water cartridge 
and comes charging back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (I will not lose! The winner will be...!)

text_block_list.name: McQueen & Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaahhhh!!! 
Uoryaaaaaaahhhh!!!

—And so, the turbulent finals came to a 
close. 
As the sun began to set, the celebration 
BBQ got underway.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah! That sauce smells so good! It looks 
delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, you're actually keeping quiet like a 
good girl... 
Hehehe...! Tough luck coming in 2nd place!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to point out that 'behaving 
yourself' 
doesn't strictly mean keeping entirely 
silent, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Just having you not speak has made things 
so wonderfully peaceful. 
Fufufu! It seems I'll be able to live in 
peace for a while.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What is it? I will not be accepting any 
complaints, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea what you are trying to 
say... Wait, what is that? 
Wait, I am NOT pouring that on! I am 
definitely not pouring that on anything—!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san, so this is where you were. 
...May I sit next to you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, of course! 
Come on over... Look, the sunset is so 
beautiful...♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wah... It really is...! It's such a 
pretty, magical color... 
It kind of makes me sad that today is 
coming to an end.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, time really flies when you're having 
fun, doesn't it? 
...I'm feeling a teensy bit lonely too...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Because... I never thought 
it would end up being this much fun...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Did you... have a good time...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You were just so strong back then, 
Chiyo-chan...! 
I was trying so hard, my mind went totally 
blank.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To be able to fight with everything you've 
got, 
to have someone who'll charge right at 
you... It really is a blessing.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Thanks to you, this became 
the best summer ever. 
It's a memory I'll never forget for the 
rest of my life!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! No, the pleasure was all mine...! 
I had so, so, so much fun being able to 
participate together with you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget it either...! 
The heat of this summer, where I got to 
fight against you at your full strength, 
Maruzen-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! I must admit, I am completely 
exhausted... 
Though... fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You know, you do not have to remain 
entirely silent.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Really?! Then lemme tell you all about 
the Chancellor Squid Rebellion! 
See, squids are always super ambitious and 
instinctively aim for the throne—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Making a ruckus is forbidden. Speak 
normally, please. 
You really are utterly incomprehensible...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, for this once... someone like you 
actually helped me realize something. 
I suppose things like this can happen, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha~n? Did you finally realize how 
awesome I am? 
Bring it on, bring it on! Shower me with 
all the praise you got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please do not let it get to your head. 
Though... well—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Only a little, but... you have my thanks. 
A lot happened, but I am glad I 
participated with you...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh? What's gotten into you? 
You had that miserable look on your face 
earlier, and now what's this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I simply spoke my mind. 
If anything, weren't you being unusually 
persistent with pestering me this time?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well duh, 'cause you looked bored out of 
your mind! 
I kept watching you, but you weren't 
molting or hibernating or nothing.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see someone like that, I just 
gotta poke 'em, y'know? 
Leave 'em alone, and nothing fun ever 
happens!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is that supposed to mean? 
Do consider how the person being poked 
feels for once.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Wait... does that mean she only bothered 
me 
because she noticed something was off with 
me...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Back then, if she hadn't suddenly said 
she was 'bored'... 
If I hadn't lost my temper at her 
attitude... I would probably still be...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. What am I doing...? 
Trying to guess your true intentions is an 
exercise in futility.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, didn't you just see an Umibozu out 
off the coast? 
Think I'll go trade business cards with 
it... Wait! I'm s'posed to be behaving 
myself, ain't I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ......Gold Ship-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You only have to behave 
until the sun sets beneath the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, please do not move during that 
time. 
Just stay like this for a little 
while......

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Just a little while is fine by ya? 
Even though you finally won? 
Gol-pippi ain't takin' responsibility for 
whatever she does after this, ya hear!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is quite alright...... After all, it 
is summer!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What does summer gotta do with—wait, you 
baited me into playin' the straight man! 
This girl... she's good!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now now, no moving! 
Ufufufufu...!
